prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right pick depends on what you need (branding vs. performance, B2B vs. B2C, scope, budget, timeline, industry expertise). 

Quick questions so I can recommend the best fits:
- What services do you need? (brand strategy, creative, website, SEO, paid media, social, PR, etc.)
- Are you B2B, B2C, nonprofit, enterprise, startup?
- Approximate monthly or project budget?
- Do you want a big full-service agency, a small specialist, or a local-only partner?
- Any examples of work or industries you want them to have experience in?

If you want some starting options now: Kansas City is home to several highly regarded agencies — for example VML (global, full-service digital + brand) and Barkley (large independent creative & brand agency). Once you tell me the answers above I’ll build a tailored shortlist of 4–6 KC agencies, with why each is a good match and suggested next steps.
